story.summaryZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔目前可能正被一种类似当年他试图扭转对刘易斯·汉密尔顿连败局面时的“疯狂动力”所驱动，以在与基米·安东内利的竞争中扭转局势。
story.originalTitle: George Russell: Mercedes driver's losses to Kimi Antonelli will feel 'painful' says Nico Rosberg as driver backed for breakthrough
story.summaryEn: Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is likely being driven by a similar "insane motivation" to turn the tables on Kimi Antonelli as he once was to get the better of Lewis Hamilton after recurring defeats.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：梅赛德斯车手输给基米·安东内利将感到“痛苦”，尼科·罗斯伯格如是说，同时这位车手被看好将迎来突破
乔治·拉塞尔在马德里赛道落后基米·安东内利81分；拉塞尔赛后承认，“实际上我已不在车手冠军的争夺中”；9月24日至26日，在天空体育 F1直播观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛的每一节练习和周六的正赛
乔治·拉塞尔谈虚拟安全车如何影响了他在西班牙大奖赛中的比赛
尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔目前将受到类似程度的“疯狂动力”驱动，以扭转对基米·安东内利的局面，就像他当年在反复失利后要战胜刘易斯·汉密尔顿一样。
拉塞尔今年首次成为世界冠军的希望日益渺茫，状态正佳的梅赛德斯队友安东内利在积分榜榜首将领先优势扩大到81分。
自从赢得3月的赛季揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛后，季前夺冠热门拉塞尔在两人均完赛的最近10场比赛中仅两次领先安东内利，这位英国人目睹这位年轻的意大利人在蒙扎-马德里背靠背比赛中拿下本赛季第七和第八场胜利。

周日的比赛后，拉塞尔获得第五名，罗斯伯格在天空体育 F1上被问及他当年在2016年从被梅赛德斯队友汉密尔顿彻底击败后反弹赢得世界冠军的经历。
“我很大程度上是被痛苦所驱动，”罗斯伯格回忆道。
“主观上，不断输给刘易斯是痛苦的，而这恰恰驱动了一种疯狂的动力。
“乔治将处于类似的情况。他现在会如此拼命地想要找到提升。
“他会非常努力，因为我知道乔治不会放弃，他讨厌被基米一次又一次击败的局面。
“他会超级努力，但这有点困难，因为很难理解他的速度去哪了。”
2026年西班牙大奖赛集锦
拉塞尔在梅赛德斯的前四个赛季中有三个赛季是车队得分最高的车手，其中三年里两次胜过汉密尔顿（2022年和2024年），一次与新人安东内利搭档（2025年），但今年要想再次做到这一点，他需要重大逆转，因为赛历上还剩九场比赛。
罗斯伯格相信，勤奋的拉塞尔会继续努力，在W17赛车上找到突破，尽管他说这位28岁的车手不可避免地也会自我怀疑。
“我对乔治的方式印象深刻，因为他确实是个完美主义者，他试图涵盖人类表现的每一个方面，”这位天空体育 F1评论员补充道。
“我知道他在竭尽所能，我钦佩这一点。
“但正因如此，这对他更难，因为他自己也不理解。他一直很快；他一直至少与队友持平，突然之间这在他那里消失了。
“这真的很痛苦，因为你开始怀疑自己。无论你多么自信，然后就会[质疑]‘我是不是不够好？我过去是不是更好，而现在只是做错了什么？’这真的很难。”
天空体育 News的克雷格·斯莱特回顾西班牙大奖赛后的所有重大话题
“实际上我不在争夺中”——拉塞尔几乎排除车手冠军可能
就在前一周在蒙扎被安东内利夺走胜利（尽管队友因罚退从第19位发车）而落后66分之后，拉塞尔在进入西班牙大奖赛周末时承认，他今年要实现冠军梦“需要一些运气”。
在马德里赛道对他而言令人失望的周末，这一差距扩大到赛季最高的81分，这个周末因排位赛Q3的困难以及正赛中早早出现的虚拟安全车而受到影响。这一结果导致拉塞尔在周日晚上几乎将自己排除在争夺之外。
在评估自己对即将到来的比赛（从9月24日至26日的阿塞拜疆大奖赛开始）的策略时，拉塞尔告诉F1：“继续推进。尽管今天的成绩远非理想，但最近几场比赛更为积极。
“但这差不多就是本赛季的写照。我只需要专注于表现，继续努力帮助车队。
“我们显然处于赢得车队冠军的有利位置，实际上我已不在车手冠军的争夺中，这让我能够只专注于一场一场地比赛，努力专注于取得一些好成绩。”
梅赛德斯副领队布拉德利·洛德和乔治·拉塞尔讨论车队如何通过青训项目支持年轻人才，并资助基层可持续燃料项目
“我们只需把它释放出来”——沃尔夫支持“顶级车手”拉塞尔找到突破
他的梅赛德斯车队仍然相信拉塞尔会找回最佳状态。
当被问及拉塞尔目前最艰难地在为什么而战时，梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫说：“我不知道，因为你能看到他在最后追赶勒克莱尔时的速度。他是赛道上最快的。
“但在换胎之后，速度就不在了。
“我就是不知道它在哪里，我们必须分析，因为显然它就在他身上，就在车里，我们只需把它释放出来。”
detailEn: George Russell: Mercedes driver's losses to Kimi Antonelli will feel 'painful' says Nico Rosberg as driver backed for breakthrough

George Russell fell 81 points behind Kimi Antonelli at the Madring; Russell conceded that "realistically I'm not in the fight for the drivers'" after the race; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from September 24-26 with a Saturday race, live on Sky Sports F1
George Russell on how the Virtual Safety Car compromised his race at the Spanish Grand Prix

Nico Rosberg believes George Russell will currently be driven by a similar level of "insane motivation" to turn the tables on Kimi Antonelli as he was to get the better of Lewis Hamilton after recurring defeats.
Russell's hopes of becoming world champion for the first time this year are increasingly slim with in-form Mercedes team-mate Antonelli opening an 81-point lead over him at the top of the standings.

Since winning March's season-opening Australian Grand Prix, pre-season title favourite Russell has only twice finished ahead of Antonelli in the last 10 races they have both completed with the Briton seeing the young Italian take his seventh and eighth wins of the season across the Monza-Madrid double header.

Rosberg was asked after Sunday's race, in which Russell finished fifth, on Sky Sports F1 about his experience of rebounding to win his world title in 2016 after being soundly beaten to the crown by Mercedes team-mate Hamilton the year before.
"I was driven a lot by the pain," recalled Rosberg.
"Subjectively, it was painful to keep losing against Lewis and that just drove an insane motivation.
"George will be in a similar situation. He will be so damn motivated at the moment to try and find improvements.
"He'll be working so hard because I know George doesn't give up and he's hating the situation of getting beaten over and over by Kimi.
"He'll be working super hard but it's a bit of a difficult one because it's hard to understand where the pace has gone for him."
Highlights from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix

Russell has been Mercedes' top-scoring driver in three of his previous four seasons at the team, twice in three years against Hamilton (2022 and 2024) and once alongside a rookie Antonelli (2025), but he requires a major turnaround for that to be the case again this year with nine scheduled races left.
Rosberg believes the diligent Russell will keep working away to find a breakthrough with the W17 car, although says it is inevitable that the 28-year-old will be questioning himself too.
"I'm very impressed with George's approach because he's really a perfectionist and he tries to cover every aspect of his human performance," added the Sky Sports F1 pundit.
"I know he's doing everything he can, and I admire that.
"But, all the more, it's tough for him because he doesn't understand himself. He's always been fast; he's always been at least level with his team-mate and suddenly it's gone away from him there.

"It's really painful because you start to doubt yourself. It doesn't matter how confident you are, it then comes [to questioning] 'am I not good enough? Was I better in the past and I'm just doing something wrong now?' It's really difficult."
Sky Sports News' Craig Slater reflects on all the big talking points after the Spanish Grand Prix
'Realistically I'm not in the fight' - Russell all-but rules out drivers' title win

Fresh from being beaten to victory by Antonelli the weekend before at Monza despite his team-mate starting a penalised 19th on the grid to fall 66 points off the pace, Russell conceded going into the Spanish Grand Prix weekend that he would "need some luck" to realise his title dreams this year.

That deficit grew to a season-high 81 points in a disappointing weekend for him at the Madring, which was compromised by a difficult Q3 in qualifying and then an early Virtual Safety Car in the race. That result led to Russell all but ruling himself out of contention on Sunday evening.

Assessing his approach for the forthcoming races, starting with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on September 24-26, Russell told F1: "Just keep pushing along. It has been a more positive couple of races even though the result was far from great today.
"But it's kind of story of the season. I just need to focus on the performance, keep trying to help the team.

"We're obviously in a great place to win the constructors', realistically I'm not in the fight for the drivers', and that just allows me just to focus on race-by-race and trying to focus on getting some good results."
Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord and George Russell discuss how the team are supporting young talent through their junior programme and backing grassroots sustainable fuel projects
'We just have to unlock it' - Wolff backing 'top driver' Russell to find breakthrough
His Mercedes team remain convinced Russell will rediscover his best form.

Asked what Russell was fighting hardest at the moment, Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said: "I don't know, because you can see the pace he had towards the end when he was catching Leclerc. He was fastest out on track.
"But after the tyre changes, the pace wasn't there.
"I just don't know where it is and we have to analyse it, because clearly it's in him, it's in the car, and we just have to unlock it."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：法拉利车队的七届F1世界冠军在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿周二访问了拉法口岸，实地了解向加沙运送援助物资的工作；这位法拉利车手周三在Instagram发帖，呼吁以色列“履行停火协议下的义务”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
汉密尔顿周二在埃及，实地了解向加沙运送人道主义与救援物资的工作。这位法拉利车手还参观了拉法口岸，并走访了埃及红新月会的援助仓库。
美国支持的以色列与哈马斯之间的停火协议仍然有效，但并未结束以色列对加沙的打击，同时联合国世界粮食计划署表示，加沙三分之二的人口难以获得足够的食物。
汉密尔顿此前曾呼吁该地区实现和平，他表示援助物资因“疯狂的理由”被拒绝进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的一条帖子。
您可以随时通过隐私选项更改您的设置。
这位七届世界冠军在Instagram上发文称：“过去三年以色列在加沙的种族灭绝行径令人震惊。”
“人们被剥夺自由、安全和尊严，这是不公正的。任何人都不应被当作生命不那么重要来对待。”
“我看到绵延数英里的围墙，是为了把他们困在里面而建的。站在外面，感觉就像一座露天监狱，我满脑子想的都是进去帮忙。”
“在拉法口岸，我看到食品卡车排着队准备出发，但它们经常不被允许进入，或者面临严重延误。我交谈过的排在第一位的那位司机已经等了超过12个小时。”
在附近的物流中心，我看到了救援人员的辛勤工作，但我也看到了因荒唐理由被拒绝的物资。睡袋、急救包、医疗设备、轮椅，甚至给孩子们的足球。
以色列需要履行停火协议下的义务，让援助卡车进入。没有任何借口。
我知道很多人都感受到同样的无助。同样觉得需要做点什么，而不是袖手旁观。我不想让我们对他们的苦难习以为常。我不想让我们移开视线。
周三，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡否认以色列在拖延物资进入加沙，并将加沙不断恶化的状况归咎于哈马斯，指责他们拒绝解除武装并截留援助物资用于军事用途。
2021年，汉密尔顿创立了Mission 44慈善机构，旨在支持年轻人并改善他们获得教育和就业机会的途径。
他还支持了人道主义和救援倡议，以及为受冲突影响的人们提供帮助的努力。
汉密尔顿是在上周末参加圣保罗大奖赛并获得第九名后进行了此次访问。他接下来将代表法拉利参加拉斯维加斯大奖赛，第一次练习赛于11月20日星期五举行。
汉密尔顿分享了与加沙儿童会面的细节
在首次发帖一天后，汉密尔顿于周四再次通过社交媒体分享了他与从加沙撤离的儿童互动的细节。
除了分享一组自己与孩子们的合影外，汉密尔顿写道：“在埃及见到一些由@inaraorg支持的从加沙撤离的巴勒斯坦儿童，我的心都碎了。
“这些美丽、聪明的孩子经历了创伤、悲痛和可怕的伤害，这些是任何孩子都不应该承受的事情。有些孩子在袭击中中弹或严重烧伤，仍在面对复杂的康复之路。但真正打动我的是他们如此坚韧，而且似乎在彼此身上找到了许多快乐。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的帖子

“当我问起他们的梦想时，他们谈到想成为老师和医生，这样就能像曾经帮助过他们的人那样去帮助别人。在经历了这一切之后，他们仍然想象着一个关爱他人的未来。这让我一直难以忘怀。
“我在学校、医院和一家心理健康诊所遇到了孩子们，帮助他们走出创伤。我还走进了一些家庭，倾听他们关于康复以及与亲人——他们的孩子、父母、兄弟姐妹——分离的故事。那种分离和不确定带来的痛苦令人难以理解。
“他们的故事让我想到了仍留在加沙的孩子们，他们生活在恶劣的条件下。据报道，自2023年10月以来，已有超过21500名儿童丧生，45000人受伤。他们每一个人都曾有过一个家和一个未来。我们不能忘记他们。
“这些孩子和你们的孩子没有不同。他们的生命同样珍贵。他们本应能在教室里与朋友相伴感到安全，与家人在一起，并憧憬未来。我非常感激我遇到的年轻人正在获得他们所需的帮助，但他们不得不离开家园去寻找安全，这令人心碎。”
加沙卫生当局表示，自2023年10月以色列开始对加沙发动攻势以来，已有超过74000人丧生。
以色列是在哈马斯武装人员对以色列南部发动袭击后发起这次攻势的，以方称该袭击造成约1200人死亡。

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari's seven-time F1 world champion urges Israel to 'let the aid trucks in' to Gaza after visit to Rafah border

Lewis Hamilton visited the Rafah border on Tuesday to witness efforts to transport aid into Gaza; Ferrari driver published Instagram post on Wednesday calling on Israel to "fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire"
Lewis Hamilton urged Israel to "let the aid trucks in" to Gaza after visiting the Rafah border.

Hamilton was in Egypt on Tuesday to witness efforts to deliver humanitarian and relief aid bound for Gaza. The Ferrari driver also toured the Rafah border crossing and visited the Egyptian Red Crescent's aid warehouses.

The US-backed ceasefire between Israel and Hamas remains in place but has not ended Israeli strikes on Gaza, while the UN World Food Programme says two-thirds of Gaza's population are struggling to get enough to eat.
Hamilton - who has previously called for peace in the region - said aid was being denied entry into Gaza for "crazy reasons".

The seven-time world champion posted on Instagram: "The past three years of Israel's genocide in Gaza is appalling.
"It's an injustice for people to be denied their freedom, their safety and their dignity. No human being should be treated as though their life matters less.
"I saw walls stretching for miles, built to keep them in. Standing there, outside what felt like an open-air prison, all I could think about was getting in to help.
"At Rafah border, I saw food trucks lined up ready to go, but they're regularly not allowed in or face major delays. The first driver in line that I spoke to had already been waiting over 12 hours.

"At the nearby logistics centre, I saw the hard work of the aid workers, but I also saw what gets rejected for crazy reasons. Sleeping bags, first-aid kits, medical equipment, wheelchairs, even footballs for kids.
"Israel needs to fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire and let the aid trucks in. No excuse.
"I know so many people feel that same helplessness. That same need to do something rather than just watch. I don't want us to get used to their suffering. I don't want us to look away."

On Wednesday, Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli Prime Minister, denied Israel was delaying the entry of supplies into Gaza, and blamed Hamas for the worsening conditions in Gaza, accusing them of a refusal to disarm and seizing aid for military use.
In 2021, Hamilton founded Mission 44, a charity aimed at supporting young people and improving ⁠access to education and employment ​opportunities.
He has also backed ​humanitarian and relief initiatives, and ​efforts to support people affected by ⁠conflict.
Hamilton made his visit after competing in the Sao Paulo GP last weekend, where he finished ninth. He will next compete for Ferrari in the Las Vegas GP, with Practice 1 on Friday November 20.
Hamilton shares details of meeting children from Gaza
A day after his initial post, Hamilton took to social media again on Thursday to share details of his interactions with children he met who have been evacuated from Gaza.

Along with sharing a selection of photos of himself with the children, Hamilton wrote: "Meeting some of the Palestinian children evacuated from Gaza and supported by @inaraorg in Egypt broke my heart.

"Beautiful, bright children who have faced trauma, grief and horrendous injuries, things no child should ever have to endure. Some have been shot or badly burned in attacks and are still facing a complicated road towards recovery. But what really struck me was how resilient they were and how much joy they seem to find in each other.

"When I asked about their dreams, they spoke about becoming teachers and doctors so they could help others, the way they were helped. After everything they've been through, they still imagine a future caring for other people. That has stayed with me.

"I met children at school, in hospital and at a mental health clinic helping them work through their trauma. I also went into families' homes and listened to their stories of recovery and being separated from loved ones - their children, their parents, their siblings. The pain of that separation and uncertainty is hard to comprehend.

"Their stories made me think about the children still in Gaza, who are living in terrible conditions. According to reports, more than 21,500 children have been killed and 45,000 injured since October 2023. Every one of them had a home and a future. We can't forget them.

"These children are no different from yours. Their lives are just as precious. They should be able to feel safe in a classroom with friends, be with their families and imagine a future. I'm so grateful the young people I met are getting the help they need, but it's heartbreaking that they've had to leave their homes to find safety."
Gaza health authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed since Israel began its Gaza assault in October 2023.
Israel launched the offensive after Hamas gunmen led an attack on southern Israel, which it said killed around 1,200.
